newsitem.title: USA: Brake Headquarters seeks merger advice.
newsitem.headline: Brake Headquarters seeks merger advice.

text.p: Brake Headquarters U.S.A. Inc said Thursday it was seeking advice on mergers, acquisitions and other issues.
The company, which makes undercar products, said it had entered into an agreement with management consulting firm Capital Advisors & Consultants Ltd.

"Successful completion of our merger and acquisition efforts will enable Brake Headquarters to fulfill our long-range plans relating to expansion into manufacturing and continued success of our current marketing and distribution business," it said.
